boss_intro: Well met, small knight. I am the wall. Walls are patient.
Courtesy first: your footwork is promising. Now — try me.
I hold this bay. I shall hold it politely, and completely.
taunt: A fine strike. The wall remains.
Take your time. I have all of mine.
You cannot rush stone, dear challenger.
hit_react: A clean hit! You honour the bout.
low_hp: My ramparts thin. Your patience bested mine.
defeat_freed: The Cog falls. And the wall bows, freely, to a worthy foe.
Defeat, gracefully accepted. My shield is yours, little knight.
You saw the flaw in my hasty barricades. Braced learning beats rushed walls.
